original.Statement / description: APC mutation is the most common initiating event in colorectal cancer, occurring in 85% of sporadic CRC and 100% of familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP).

original.Statement / description: VHL loss-of-function mutation occurs in 70-80% of clear cell RCC, leading to constitutive HIF-1a stabilization regardless of oxygen levels, creating a pseudo-hypoxic state and constitutive VEGF expression.

original.Statement / description: Metformin inhibits Complex I, decreasing mitochondrial NADH oxidation and impairing the malate-aspartate shuttle, which reduces OAA for PEPCK and primary gluconeogenesis.
